content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"The records flag as an open, medium-severity risk that fragmented definitions, reporting formats and data systems had made it difficult to measure progress consistently and spotlight inequalities in India.","cites":["risk:1"]},{"claim":"The Government of India launched the Swachh Bharat (Clean India) Mission in 2014, and 110 million toilets were constructed under it.","cites":["fact:01a126b0-e8c0-733e-a071-60efb264ab08","kpi:6"]},{"claim":"India reached 580 million people with improved drinking water and 550 million people with basic sanitation in the last 10 years.","cites":["kpi:3","kpi:2"]},{"claim":"In 2024, 59.3 million people in India were accessing safely managed water and 17.9 million were accessing safely managed sanitation.","cites":["kpi:10","kpi:9"]},{"claim":"India launched the Jal Jeevan (Water is Life) Mission to achieve universal access to safe and adequate drinking water.","cites":["fact:01a126b0-e8c0-733e-a071-60efb3a6acd3"]},{"claim":"The Government of India invested over $120 billion in water and sanitation.","cites":["kpi:5"]}]}
